title: Library exclusions for playback alerts
summary: Choose Jellyfin libraries that should not send playback notifications, while keeping their activity in History and Statistics.
highlights: Select libraries under Settings > Exclusions > Notifications. This setting is separate from user notification exclusions and Statistics library exclusions.
When library exclusions are active, Jellydash waits for a new play's library before sending an alert. A play still missing that information after 10 minutes expires without an alert.
For Docker or manual configuration, PUSH_IGNORE_LIBRARIES provides an optional fallback. Saved Settings values take priority, including an empty selection.
